ge-gate.title: GE time per frame in Phobos against my PSP-1000
ge-gate.alt: All eight judged scenes are within 15 percent of the PSP-1000's frame time, between 12.69 percent faster for Super Monkey Ball and 9.95 percent slower for Activision Hits' 3D menu.
ge-gate.source_md: Each scene's GE time for a whole frame in Phobos against my capture of it on my PSP-1000, from the gate table in [part 115](https://github.com/pwnedbygary/phobos/blob/master/docs/psp-core.md) of docs/psp-core.md (#291). The shaded band is the 15% limit.

ge-list-time.title: GE time for one display list on my PSP-1000 and in Phobos's old model
ge-list-time.alt: Bars for five game scenes. My PSP-1000's GE took 4.46 to 29.6 milliseconds per display list, where Phobos's old model charged 0.59 to 6.24.
ge-list-time.source_md: I measured these on 16 October 2026 with a GE profiler under custom firmware on my PSP-1000, against what Phobos's model charged then. Data from [docs/progress/data.json](https://github.com/pwnedbygary/phobos/blob/master/docs/progress/data.json).
